notes: Identity role with no frame function and no formats(), like copy: native has no query_formats, so every source keeps its own format (17 negotiation sources matched, none refused).
The descriptor round trip is the identity on the 14 storage formats: 84 checks that native rawvideo equals the input at all six sizes, consistent with the macOS md5 probe in the spec.
Registry examples: pixdesctest, pixdesctest,hflip, format=nv12,pixdesctest; run on all five paths by the unedited registry test.
No Linux-gated cases: byte copy only; the implicit format=nv12 conversion runs with -cpuflags 0 natively and scalar arithmetic here.
Native statuses: EINVAL is read from os.constants.errno on the host for pixdesctest=1; the other refusal statuses are FFERRTAG low bytes, not errno.
Identity forwards the same frame object, so stride or storage defects are detected by the next materializing operator, not by pixdesctest; unit-tested via pixdesctest,hflip.

Reference built in the sandbox with --allow-unpinned-reference; sha differs from the linux-x64 pin (5e43da9ad1ee) as expected for a different compiler; tests assert commit 946fcce0 and --disable-x86asm only.
